skill.name: fresh-eyes-review
skill.description: Guides a final fresh-eyes review before commits, pull requests, or release handoff. It focuses on security vulnerabilities, logic errors, business rules, and performance issues that tests can miss.
skill.summary: Run a focused final code review before committing or shipping changes.
skill.author: 2389-research

content.value_statement: Teams ship bugs when final changes are trusted too quickly. This skill adds a focused pre-commit review for security, logic, business rules, and performance.
actual_capabilities: Guides a final review before commit, pull request, deployment, or completion handoff.
Checks common security issues, including SQL injection, XSS, path traversal, command injection, IDOR, and auth bypass.
Prompts review of logic errors, business rules, performance issues, and edge cases.
Directs users to fix findings, add tests, and rerun validation before declaring work done.
Provides time guidance and a required completion summary for review accountability.
limitations: It does not execute tests, linters, or scanners by itself.
It depends on the reviewer having access to the changed files and project context.
Its examples are TypeScript oriented, though the checklist applies broadly.
It can add process time for very small or urgent changes.

use_cases.title: Pre-Commit Quality Gate
use_cases.description: Run a short final review before committing code to catch missed security and logic issues.

use_cases.title: Pull Request Readiness Check
use_cases.description: Verify that a change is ready for review by checking edge cases, business rules, and validation steps.

use_cases.title: Security-Focused Final Pass
use_cases.description: Use the checklist to look for injection, authorization, traversal, and output handling problems before release.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Basic Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review after finishing a small code change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a fresh-eyes review on my changed files before I commit. Focus on security, logic errors, and missing validation.

prompt_templates.title: Check Pull Request Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review before opening a pull request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this branch for pull request readiness. Check the changed files for business rules, edge cases, performance, and test gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Sensitive Feature
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review for authentication, billing, or data access changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a fresh-eyes review of this sensitive feature. Prioritize auth bypass, IDOR, injection, data leakage, and incorrect authorization boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Release Readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced final pass before deployment or merge.
prompt_templates.prompt: Do a release-readiness fresh-eyes review. List each issue found, the fix needed, validation steps, and any residual risk before I ship.

output_examples.input: Review a four-file authentication change before commit.
output: Fresh-eyes review started for four files.
Found missing email validation and an authorization check that depended only on a request parameter.
Recommended adding validation, enforcing server-side ownership checks, and rerunning tests.

output_examples.input: Check a pagination update for pull request readiness.
output: Reviewed security, logic, business rules, and performance concerns.
Found an off-by-one pagination condition and a missing maximum page size.
Suggested boundary tests and a response size limit before opening the pull request.

output_examples.input: Run a final pass on a billing calculation change.
output: Checked rounding, zero values, error messages, and test coverage.
Found currency rounding applied after aggregation instead of per line item.
Recommended matching the documented billing rule and adding regression coverage.

best_practices: Run the review after implementation and tests, but before commit or pull request creation.
Review only the changed files and directly related code to keep the pass focused.
Fix findings immediately and add tests that prove the issue stays fixed.
anti_patterns: Skipping the review because tests already pass.
Using the checklist as a substitute for automated tests or security scanners.
Declaring the review complete without recording issues found, fixes made, and validation run.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it after implementation and tests, before a commit, pull request, deployment, or completion handoff.

faq.question: Does it replace normal code review?
faq.answer: No. It is a final self-review step that helps catch issues before human review or release.

faq.question: Does it run security tools automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides a review process and checklist. You still need to run project tests, linters, and scanners.

faq.question: What kinds of bugs does it target?
faq.answer: It targets injection, access control, path traversal, logic errors, business rule mistakes, and performance problems.

faq.question: Can it be used outside TypeScript projects?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples use TypeScript, but the review categories apply to most software projects.

faq.question: How long should the review take?
faq.answer: The skill suggests about two minutes for small changes and up to five minutes for larger focused reviews.
